assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: portrait expression atlas for an offline Japanese story game.
Edit target: the supplied reference portrait. Produce ONE single atlas image in landscape aspect ratio 3:2, ideally 1536 x 1024, arranged as EXACTLY THREE COLUMNS and TWO ROWS of equally sized SQUARE portraits. All six portraits show exactly the same adult woman from the input image, at exactly the same head-and-upper-chest scale and face position. Each square is filled edge-to-edge with her portrait and the same existing backdrop. No gutters, borders, labels, writing, watermark or decorative panels.
Preserve her individual identity very carefully: exact facial proportions, hair style and colour, skin texture, hairstyle, costume, accessories, lighting and photorealistic rendering style of the input. Do not beautify or change her apparent age. Keep gaze broadly near camera and body posture consistent. Change only facial expression, including clearly legible natural eyebrow, eyelid, lip and cheek changes.
Six square cells in this exact row-major order:
TOP LEFT: calm / composed, neutral relaxed closed lips, attentive eyes.
TOP CENTER: warm / gentle happiness, noticeably smiling lips and softly smiling eyes, restrained friendly warmth.
TOP RIGHT: thoughtful / troubled and a little sad, inner eyebrows gently raised, mouth subdued, eyes showing concern.
BOTTOM LEFT: determined / serious resolve, brows slightly drawn down, eyes firm and focused, closed firm lips; no anger or exaggerated scowl.
BOTTOM CENTER: surprised / natural moderate surprise, clearly widened eyes and raised eyebrows, slightly parted lips; still realistic.
BOTTOM RIGHT: blush / shy affection, subtly rosy cheeks, slightly bashful softer gaze with a small hesitant smile; no hands over face.
Make all six expressions noticeably different while staying mature, plausible and photorealistic. Keep every full face and hair within its own cell so the atlas can be cropped automatically.
Subject invariants specific to this reference: short tousled brown hair, faint freckles, orange-and-navy work coveralls over a pale grey crewneck shirt, sunlit blue boat workshop behind her. Use the exact woman from the reference.
